slots.label: Figure 3
slots.default: Cloud Migration, Managed Cloud Services, IT Support

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Ixia Clinical needed to migrate from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 while maintaining data integrity and avoiding any disruption to clinical operations. All email, documents, shared drives and meetings had to transfer without loss or downtime.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: WhizzIT managed the complete migration: preparing the Microsoft 365 environment, transferring all 10 users and 1TB+ of email and files, and sequencing the switchover to prevent disruption. We validated the successful arrival of mail, files and calendars before retiring the legacy platform, with ongoing IT support in place once the move was done.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: The business moved onto Microsoft 365 smoothly, email, files and calendars all arrived intact, and now has professional IT support available on demand whenever the team needs it.
